name: CRPG
description: A party of interlocking builds fighting real-time-with-pause tactical encounters, talking through branching dialogue where stats open doors, and living with consequences factions remember. Dialogue and consequence remain the genre spine; tactical pause, queued party orders and prepared spells now give its combat the same explicit ownership boundaries. The quest and dialogue core now adds staged objectives, restorable once-only choices, deterministic checks, exactly-once mixed rewards, and dedicated quest and narrative journals.
loop: party of builds → real-time-with-pause encounters → dialogue choices → branching story

signatureCompound.name: Branching Encounter
signatureCompound.description: Walk the party in under party_formation, talk through dialogue_tree_engine with attribute_sheet rolling the checks, and let reputation_system plus the quest log turn the outcome into standing the next quest gate reads. Combat is optional; consequence is not.
